intent: Reproduce the vendor Form preset "Flowing Rectangle Grid" (Shape Grids); reference thumbnail: /Users/renzhongyi/Documents/AE_plugins_proj/recipe-harness/mining/thumbs/TC14/Form/Shape Grids/Flowing Rectangle Grid.png

iterations.critique: The render has the core look of the preset: a black field of orange vertical rectangular particles with animated, flowing areas of reduced visibility. Motion is present between frames, with the dark flow regions and brighter bars shifting organically. However, the grid reads substantially too sparse and oversized for the 1280×720 composition: only about 35 columns are visible despite the intended 56-particle horizontal grid, suggesting the 1920×1080 base-shape dimensions were not adapted to the current comp. This makes the pattern feel cropped rather than like a full rectangle grid.

The composition now reads as the intended full 56×10 flowing rectangle grid across the 1280×720 frame, rather than the previously oversized/cropped sparse grid. The small orange vertical rectangles, black background, broad organic dark-flow regions, and visible evolution from t1 to t4 closely match the preset’s core visual behavior.
